name: Minazuki Haruka
source:
Always cheerful and energetic, she is the mood maker at the school. She is good at sports, especially swimming, but she is not very good at studying and is a regular student at extra lessons. After losing her parents in an accident at a young age, she was taken in by the Kannazuki family, where she lives with Aoi. She transforms into Red Angel and uses her footwork to defeat her targets in close combat. Her special moves are 'Angel Tornado' and 'Angel Impact'.

[Translated from the [url=https://twin-angel-psp.com/character.html]official site[/url]]
